message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, cult‑favorite, and contemporary horror flicks—plus a few hidden gems—to satisfy almost any taste:

| # | Title & Year | Director(s) | Why It Stands Out |
|---|--------------|-------------|--------------------|
| **1** | *Psycho* (1960) – Alfred Hitchcock | Masterclass in suspense + iconic shower scene |
| **2** | *Halloween* (1978) – John Carpenter | Birthplace of the “slasher” genre & Michael Myers’ chilling presence |
| **3** | *The Shining* (1980) – Stanley Kubrick | Psychological terror set against isolation & supernatural dread |
| **4** | *Candyman* (1992) – Bernard Rose | Urban legend meets social critique; unforgettable visual style |
| **5** | *Scream* (1996) – Wes Craven | Self‑aware meta‑horror that revitalized the slasher formula |
| **6** | *28 Days Later…* (2002) – Danny Boyle | Fast‑moving zombie outbreak redefined the genre |
| **7** | *Paranormal Activity* (2007) – Oren Peli | Found‑footage realism sparked a new wave of low‑budget scares |
| **8** | *Hereditary* (2018) – Ari Aster | Family drama turned into bone‑chilling cosmic horror |
| **9** | *Midsommar* (2019) – Ari Aster | Daylight folk‑festival nightmare that flips expectations |
| **10** | *A Quiet Place* (2018) – John Krasinski | Silence becomes survival strategy; tense atmosphere |
| **11** | *Get Out* (2017) – Jordan Peele | Horror + sharp social satire; smart storytelling |
| **12** | *It Follows* (2014) – David Robert Mitchell | Creepy premise (“you’ll never escape”) plus retro vibes |

### Quick Streaming Guide (as of May 2026)

| Film | Where You Can Watch |
|------|---------------------|
| *Psycho*, *Halloween*, *The Shining* | Classic library on HBO Max / Amazon Prime Video |
| *Candyman*, *Scream* | Peacock Premium / Hulu |
| *28 Days Later…*, *Paranormal Activity* | Netflix (regional libraries vary) |
| *Hereditary*, *Midsommar*, *A Quiet Place*, *Get Out* | Paramount+ / Disney+ (depending on region) |
| *It Follows* | Apple TV+ (in select markets) |

> **Tip:** If you’re looking for something less mainstream, try indie releases from festivals such as *The Babadook* (2014), *Kill List* (2011), or *The Witch* (2015).

Enjoy your scare-filled marathon! 🎬👻
